feat(ios): add swift package manager support (#1785)

React Native 0.88 can build iOS apps with Swift Package Manager instead
of CocoaPods. A library needs a Package.swift for this; without one,
`npx react-native spm add` stops with "Package.swift is missing".

Add a Package.swift that builds ios/ as the RNShare library, with
RCT_NEW_ARCH_ENABLED=1 and LinkPresentation linked, as the podspec does.
Add two header shims SwiftPM needs, a prefix header that matches the
CocoaPods one, and swiftpmConfig.name in package.json. No file under
ios/ or src/ changes, so CocoaPods builds are not
